notes.title: RoadMap
notes.content:
I wanted to be straight-up and honest here. I am very proud of what I have created over the past 3 months. Yes, that's how long I've been working on Collision. However, there is a lot more work to be done. One major focus of the release on Friday will be the story. However, I would like to commit to a re-write of the story in first-third. I learned some new techniques regarding storytelling closer to the end of development of First-Third that I would like to go back and put into first third as an update. So, I would like to set myself a public checklist for the future of Collision before work begins on Second-Third.

Content Update #1
1. 2 new sidequests
2. Upgraded tutorial
3. Small re-writes to side character dialogue
4. Upgraded mapping in dungeons

Content Update #2
1. Optimizations-this will allow easier implementation of new features
2. Re-Writes of major story scenes
3. Sandbox mode
4. 2 new sidequests
5. Re-balancing

Content Update #3
1. New City-Caledo
2. Jobs(Accountant and Bartender)
3. New story scene
4. New character introduced
5. 5 new sidequests

Content Update #4
1. New story scene
2. New City
3. 3 new sidequests
4. Training Dojo
5. Side Dungeon
6. New jobs
7. New character becomes playable

notes.title: Giant Info Dump
notes.content:
We are getting close to launch. Here are 8 pieces of information to be shared about Collision.

1. Collision will be on Steam, itch.io, and Gamejolt. After bug fixes, content updates, and all that jazz, work will begin on porting to Xbox and Windows Store. No promises on the Xbox port being released, but I can promise that it will be attempted. To the best of my ability.

2. A trailer will be released a few days after launch.  This trailer will oversee the content being added in the future and showcasing the Roadmap.

3. Content updates will include an updated intro, some texture touch-ups, new music, jobs, new businesses, rebalancing, and an entire new dungeon floor along with a teaser for second third. I was planning on releasing the teaser in the original version, but due to a lot of problems and unforeseen issues in personal life, it will need to be delayed so testing can be completed.

4. First-Third will be focused on setting up two of the main characters. Second-Third will be focused on solving the murder mystery, and Final-Third will be focused on defeating the evil looming over Daniel's dimension.

5. There are few sidequests in the original release. I will be slowly adding more sidequests leading up to Second-Third to keep people engaged.

6. Sandbox mode will allow players to test new features as they are developed. Most of these features will be introduced during the story of Second-Third. So that is why there will be a separate mode.

7. Cheat codes will be implemented in content updates. 

8. Collision First-Third has gone gold as of July 25th. This means it is ready for release.

notes.title: Info Dump
notes.content:
Sorry, but I missed out on the updates I had planned the past two days due to things in my personal life.  Sometimes, things can be a bit unpredictable when its only just me working. So, I apologize. So, here's 3 pieces of info beneath this paragraph.

1. Your main character is Daniel.  Everyone say "Hi Daniel!!"
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42547891/2721769a2df6e57595da06ec5b8eb337b47e0726.png
He has gotten into some trouble with the law before the events of the game.  This causes him to be arrested, starting his adventure and leading him to meet a few of his friends that will accompany him on his journey.  It's always been tough for him and his family, even more so when his Father left for war.

2. There will be two dungeons in Collision:First-Third.  Each chapter will increase the number of dungeons.  First Third is the smallest chapter by far with only two dungeons and 5 dungeon floors total.  Second-third will increase this by over double.

3. There will be a mode added into First-Third a few days after launch. This mode will only be available during Early Access. Sandbox mode will allow you to test new features as they are added into the game.  This will allow me to show progress without needing to introduce features into the story earlier than intended.
